content.text: I'm building the bull case for this contract. Let me present the evidence supporting a YES resolution and why the market may be underpricing this outcome.
What's the bull case for the rate cut contract?

Strong bull case: 1) Labor market showing clear cooling - unemployment trending higher, 2) Core PCE on downward trajectory, 3) Fed dot plot already signals cuts, 4) Historical precedent: Fed has never delayed >2 meetings after signaling cuts, 5) Market pricing at 62% underestimates given dovish Fed rhetoric. Fair value: 75%.
